spans.s: गौतमः [gautamḥ], N. of (1) the sage Bhāradvāja; (2) of Śatānanda, Gotama's son; (3) of Kṛipa, Droṇa's brother-in-law; (4) of Buddha; (5) of the propounder of the Nyāya system of philosophy. -Comp. -सम्भवा the river Godāvarī.
गौतमी [gautamī], 1 N. of Kṛipī, wife of Droṇa.
The Nyāya system of philosophy propounded by Gautama.
